## Review checklist

<!-- Check only verified items. Explain any N/A or exception rather than
checking an inapplicable item. This template does not run or enforce CI gates. -->

- [ ] In-scope behavior and edge cases are covered by the linked evidence.
- [ ] Specifications, plans, tasks, code, and user-facing documentation agree where applicable.
- [ ] Actual validation results and checks not run are disclosed.
- [ ] Relevant regressions are compared with the baseline.
- [ ] Constitution compliance and any exceptions have been reviewed.
- [ ] Compatibility, migration, and rollback implications have been addressed where applicable.
- [ ] Required reviews and approvals are recorded, not assumed.
